item.title: Spartans rally past North Sanpete behind second-half comeback
item.description: MT. PLEASANT – The region-leading Emery Spartans traveled to face the North Sanpete Hawks on Wednesday night and escaped with a hard-fought 67-60 victory behind a strong second-half rally. The first half belonged to the Hawks, who outscored Emery in both quarters and carried a seven-point lead into halftime.
